Tool prices and calibration fees

These are the prices for Northwind Tools products and services, valid for orders placed directly with us. Prices include the calibration certificate but exclude delivery, which is charged at cost.

Tools

The TW-200 click-type torque wrench costs ₹4,999 and covers 20 to 210 newton metres. The TW-050 wrench for smaller fasteners costs ₹3,450 and covers 5 to 50 newton metres. The 24-piece impact socket set costs ₹2,780 and is supplied in a steel case.

Calibration service

Recalibration of a wrench bought from us costs ₹850 per tool and takes three working days in the laboratory. Recalibration of a wrench from another manufacturer costs ₹1,150 because it requires an additional adaptor set and a longer soak period before measurement. Workshops sending more than ten tools at once are handled as a batch and returned together.

Full specifications are on the TW-200 product page. Background on the calibration laboratory is on the company page, and the selection guide explains which range to buy for a given job.

Prices last reviewed 11 August 2026.
